# @ullgren/opencode-berget-usage

[OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin that surfaces your [Berget.ai](https://berget.ai) seat
budget usage inside the terminal UI: usage bars in the sidebar, a detailed session panel, a
daily-budget reset command, and automatic quota-block recovery.

## What it does

- **Sidebar block** — daily/weekly/monthly usage bars + percentages and the weekly
  self-service reset allowance. When the seat cannot be identified or a fetch fails, the error
  text replaces the bars (it colors the sidebar; it is not a dialog or toast).
- **`/berget:usage`** (also in the command palette) — session panel with the three periods,
  ticking reset countdowns, per-model usage split and the weekly reset allowance.
- **`/berget:reset`** — confirm dialog (live daily usage, natural reset countdown, remaining
  weekly resets) that asks the server part to POST the daily-budget reset.
- **Quota-block recovery** — when a berget model call fails with 429 *and* the daily budget is
  truly exhausted (≥ 100%), the same confirm-and-reset dialog is offered automatically. Plain
  per-minute rate limits (daily < 100%) recover on their own and are ignored.

## Requirements

- OpenCode V2
- Berget connected via `opencode auth login`, with
  [`@bergetai/opencode-auth`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bergetai/opencode-auth) in your
  plugins — this plugin does **not** handle credentials itself. It resolves the active
  `berget` connection through the integration framework, so the auth plugin's OAuth refresh
  stays in charge of keeping the token valid.

## Installation

Add it to the `plugins` list in `opencode.json(c)` (or your config layering):

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    "@bergetai/opencode-auth@1.2.0",
    "@ullgren/opencode-berget-usage@^0.1.0"
  ]
}
```

One entry loads both parts — the server part (budget polling, reset RPC, retry hook) and the
TUI part (sidebar block, commands, panel). Config changes reload without restart; use
`/reload` to force a full one.

## Configuration

| Variable            | Default                 | Purpose                                                      |
| ------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `BERGET_API_URL`    | `https://api.berget.ai` | API base URL                                                 |
| `BERGET_USAGE_DEBUG`| unset                   | `1` logs raw daily percent per budgets fetch and full error shape on every berget 429 |

Refresh cadence (60 s poll, 15 s fetch guard, 5 min quota-block cooldown) is fixed in
`src/index.ts`.

## API notes

The seat endpoints used here are observed from the Berget console and are (as of writing)
undocumented in Berget's public API spec:

- `GET /v1/seats/budgets` — seat budget usage per period
- `GET /v1/auth/status` — the caller's own `seatId` (used to pick the right seat out of the
  budgets response, which can contain seats beyond your own)
- `POST /v1/seats/{seatId}/budget/reset` — daily-budget reset, capped by a weekly allowance
  (`dailyResets`)

If Berget changes these shapes, the plugin degrades into its error state rather than showing
another seat's numbers.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
```

The package ships raw TypeScript/TSX (`exports` point at `src/*.ts(x)`); OpenCode resolves it
at runtime, so there is no build step.

Test the packed artifact rather than a linked copy:

```sh
npm pack
# in a scratch project's opencode.jsonc:
#   "plugins": ["file:///abs/path/ullgren-opencode-berget-usage-0.1.0.tgz"]
```

## Publishing

Releases are published manually by the maintainer — `npm publish` from a checked-out, clean tree. There is no CI release workflow; do not publish or cut releases for the maintainer.
